summary: CI workflow running build+test on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest (matrix added in #159, after ubuntu-only CI hid months of Windows-only bugs). Requires an explicit top-level `permissions: contents: read` block — its absence trips CodeQL's actions/missing-workflow-permissions check; the workflow only checks out/builds/tests so read-only is correct, matching the same block in verify-149-windows-hide.yml.
